compiled:
📰 General

Seahawks Secure Superstar Center Tyler Linderbaum in Massive Free Agency Move •

The Seattle Seahawks secured the services of star center Tyler Linderbaum following the team’s Super Bowl victory. The Seahawks defeated the New England Patriots 29-13 in Super Bowl LX, largely due to a dominant offensive line performance. This victory solidified the team’s commitment to investing in its core players. Linderbaum’s acquisition represents a significant investment in the team’s future.

🌍 World

NATO Missile Defense Successfully Intercepts Ballistic Missile Over Turkey •

NATO’s air defense systems successfully intercepted a ballistic missile approaching Turkey on Monday. The Turkish defense ministry confirmed the interception occurred as the missile entered Turkish airspace. This marks the second time NATO has successfully defended Turkish territory against a projectile originating from Iran. The incident follows recent U.S. and Israeli military actions targeting Iran, raising concerns about regional escalation.

🦅 US

Hilary Duff Reveals Limited Contact with Father Following Divorce Revelation •

Hilary Duff discussed the lasting impact of her parents’ divorce on the “On Purpose” podcast with Jay Shetty. She detailed how the separation influenced her perspective on her own marriage and subsequent divorce from Mike Comrie. Duff described the separation as “short” and emphasized its significant effect on her emotional development. The conversation centered on the complexities of familial relationships and their influence on personal choices.

💰 Business

California Gas Prices Surge Past $5 a Gallon Due to Iran War Concerns •

California gas prices have risen above $5 a gallon, primarily driven by anxieties surrounding the ongoing war in Iran and its potential impact on global oil supplies. Data from the American Automobile Association (AAA) indicates a significant increase, making California the most expensive market for gasoline in the United States. The rise is attributed to heightened concerns about disruptions to oil production and transportation routes stemming from the conflict. Experts predict continued volatility in the market as geopolitical tensions persist.

💻 Technology

Apple Rolls Out iOS 26.4 Beta 4, Bringing New Features to iPhone Users •

Apple has released iOS 26.4 beta 4, marking the fourth iteration of the public beta version for the upcoming operating system update. This release follows the previous developer beta versions, indicating progress towards the final release. The update includes several new features and improvements, though specific details remain undisclosed at this time. Developers and users can now download and test the beta version on compatible iPhone models.

🎭 Entertainment

Paramount Chief Jeff Shell Faces $150 Million Lawsuit Over Contract Dispute •

Jeff Shell, President of Paramount Skydance, is being sued for $150 million by R.J. Cipriani. Cipriani claims he was owed the sum for crisis communications services provided to the company. The lawsuit also alleges Shell refused to assist in the production of a television show. Legal documents detail the plaintiff’s claims regarding contractual obligations and denied support for a specific project.

🏅 Sports

Raiders 2026 Free Agency Tracker: Early Moves and Signings Underway •

The Las Vegas Raiders are actively participating in the 2026 NFL free agency period, beginning negotiations with available players as of Monday at noon ET. Reports detail the team’s interest in several key positions, with analysts providing grades on potential signings. The Raiders’ front office is tracking emerging free agents and evaluating their fit within the team’s roster strategy. This ongoing tracking will provide updates on player movement throughout the offseason.

🔬 Science

Fruit Fly Brain Successfully Uploaded to Computer, Offering New Research Path •

Scientists have created the world’s first “multi-behavior brain upload,” utilizing a digital model of a fruit fly’s brain containing 125,000 neurons. The project, housed within a computer, allows researchers to observe and analyze the fly’s complex behaviors in real-time. This innovative approach aims to provide valuable insights into neurological disorders. Researchers believe this technology could ultimately contribute to understanding and treating conditions affecting the human brain.

🩺 Health

Young Boy Dies Years After Measles Exposure, Highlighting Vaccine Risks •

A seven-year-old boy in Sacramento has died from a brain condition linked to a previous measles infection. Health officials identified over 100 children as potentially exposed to an unvaccinated individual at an educational program. Investigations revealed the boy’s illness developed years after the initial measles exposure, demonstrating the potential for long-term complications. Experts emphasize the importance of vaccination in preventing such outcomes and protecting vulnerable populations.
